items.title: Roblox says more than 80% of its top 100 games used AI to accelerate creation
items.excerpt: Roblox's Q3 earnings say more than 80% of its top 100 games used AI to speed up creation in October, time spent in its AI tools tripled among top creators since Q2, and daily use of its MCP Server rose nearly five-fold.

items.title: Studio Atelico launches AI engine built to run on-device inside games
items.excerpt: Studio Atelico opened early access to the Atelico AI Engine, which runs language models, image generation, speech and AI character behaviours entirely on the player's device inside the game process; it already powers the studio's creature-battler Bobium Brawlers.

items.title: Playgama launches AI Game Index to rank coding agents by real player engagement
items.excerpt: Playgama's AI Game Index ranks AI models and coding agents by how the games they build actually perform with players - playtime, likes and share of new games on its web platform.

items.title: 'Morale has been terrible' at EA, workers claim, saying that AI mandates and mismanagement have left the company in dysfunction
items.excerpt: EA developers describe top-down mandates to use generative AI tools such as Claude in daily work, alongside layoffs, as a key driver of collapsing morale inside the publisher.

items.title: The 50 most-played Steam Next Fest demos include 7 incremental games, 4 AI disclosures, and only one instance of haystack slop
items.excerpt: A breakdown of October's 50 most-played Next Fest demos finds four carry Steam generative-AI disclosures and only one AI clone of the viral haystack game made the top tier.

items.title: As EA kills Mass Effect 5, BioWare co-founder slams "weird belief" you can recreate great games with random people and AI
items.excerpt: Greg Zeschuk says business-focused executives wrongly believe great games can be rebuilt with interchangeable staff and AI tools, after EA's cancellation of Mass Effect 5.

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero has been out for less than 1 day, yet first mods adding NVIDIA DLSS 5 support have already dropped
items.excerpt: A day-one mod injects NVIDIA's DLSS 5 neural rendering runtime into Phantom Blade Zero via ReShade and RenoDX, routing the game's existing DLSS calls through the neural renderer.

items.title: 대학생 70명 참여, 콘진원 인공지능 해커톤 연다
items.excerpt: 한국콘텐츠진흥원 게임인재원이 11월 5~6일 판교에서 대학생 70명이 AI를 활용해 무박 2일 동안 게임을 만드는 'AI 해커톤' 본선을 연다. 주제는 다양성과 포용이다.

items.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark powers neural rendering and AI characters in games
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's developer blog lays out how games can use neural rendering and on-device AI characters on RTX Spark, its new Windows PC platform for AI development, creation and gaming in slim laptops and compact desktops.

items.title: Thin, light and built for everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows laptops gain new models, agent tools and games
items.excerpt: RTX Spark Windows laptops are now on sale, and NVIDIA is adding new local AI models, agent tools for developers and creators, and games for the platform.

items.title: Virtue And A Sledgehammer declares war on AI
items.excerpt: Deconstructeam's new narrative game Virtue and a Sledgehammer is explicitly about AI - tools like ChatGPT and Claude invading work and home life - and builds toward the player taking a sledgehammer to a data center.

items.title: 크래프톤 "AI 활용 방식 개선…API 비용 37% 줄여"
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 자체 'LLM 게이트웨이'를 구축해 98종 이상의 AI 모델을 사내에 제공하고 사용량을 통합 관리한 결과 API 비용을 37% 줄였다고 밝혔다. 2027년에는 AI 에이전트 관리 체계를 고도화한다.

items.title: 크래프톤 렐루게임즈, '미메시스' 대규모 업데이트…AI 몬스터 강화
items.excerpt: AI 기반 NPC 몬스터가 플레이어의 모습·행동·목소리를 모방하는 'AI 네이티브' 협동 공포게임 미메시스가 1주년 업데이트로 AI 몬스터를 고도화하고 '편집증' 시스템을 추가했다.

items.title: 크래프톤, 독자 개발 LLM '라온-1 미니' 프리뷰 공개
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 자체 개발한 30B급 거대언어모델 '라온-1 미니' 프리뷰를 허깅페이스에 공개했다. 한국어 대화와 에이전트 역량, 빠른 응답 속도를 강점으로 내세운다.

items.title: Microsoft and Epic Games suddenly agree that AI is theft
items.excerpt: As AI-powered decomps and recomps flood GitHub and DMCA notices pile up, Kotaku argues Microsoft and Epic - both loud about using generative AI in their own development - now treat AI copies of their games as theft.

items.title: AI has triggered a PS5 homebrew gold rush, but it's also the reason GTA 6 can't be pirated at release
items.excerpt: AI-assisted reverse engineering has flooded the PS5 homebrew scene with exploits; one hacker used AI to find a hypervisor exploit and reported it to Sony, closing the hole before GTA 6 launches.

items.title: Following Samson dev's bankruptcy, its founder is considering how AI might factor into new studio plans
items.excerpt: Liquid Swords founder Christofer Sundberg says a new studio would use generative AI for prototyping, repetitive production tasks and testing - not to replace roles - and that 'AI-first' is not a production plan.

items.title: Viral haystack game dev finds creative way to mock AI clones
items.excerpt: Facing a wave of AI-generated Steam clones before launch, the developer of Needle in a Haystack Simulator - a physics pile of about five million pieces of hay - hit back at the copycats with a creative jab, as Valve declines to gatekeep AI games.

items.title: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition was "not a Creative Assembly developed game," says Total War VP after it was pulled amid generative AI concerns
items.excerpt: Total War VP Roger Collum says the externally developed Shogun 2 re-release, pulled over AI-generated art accusations, slipped through because internal teams took their eyes off outsourced work.
